What is the point at which the weight of an object appears to act?
A
the centre of gravity of the object
B
the density of the object
C
the moment of a force about a point
D
the pressure on the object due to its depth

options.label: A
options.text: the centre of gravity of the object

options.label: C
options.text: the moment of a force about a point

options.label: D
options.text: the pressure on the object due to its depth
